-- 18. Display every possible combination of books and members
SELECT Books.book_name,Members.member_name 
FROM Books CROSS JOIN Members;

-- 19. Count the total number of combinations generated by the CROSS JOIN
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_combinations 
FROM Books CROSS JOIN Members;

-- 20. Display combinations of members and books belonging only to the Technology category
SELECT Members.member_name,Books.book_name 
FROM Members CROSS JOIN Books 
WHERE Books.category='Technology';
